description: AdaRES-B0: a self-authored 3D referring expression segmentation baseline whose per-query confidence is the point-weighted soft IoU between the query's own mask and a language-conditioned target-occupancy field, trained with an explicit pairwise IoU ranking loss.
constraints: Use server-2 GPUs 0 and 1 only; never use server-6.
Train from the released SPFormer sparse-UNet backbone; the decoder is authored in this project.
Report mIoU, Acc@0.25, Acc@0.5, active queries, latency, and peak memory.
Do not tune thresholds, temperatures, loss weights, feature subsets, or training epochs on ScanRefer validation.
banned: Do not report the released b005/CFNet checkpoints as AdaRES-B0 results.
Do not scan the ranking margin or the occupancy loss weight on validation.
